voiceText: [calm] Singapore students and working holiday makers, Australia announced visa changes on 17 September 2026. Family members will be restricted on most new student and graduate visas, with exceptions for ASEAN and Pacific applicants and some courses like PhDs. Course changes used to extend a stay will face new assessment. Second and third year working holiday visas will move to ballots, proposed at 45,000 and 5,000 places. These are announcements, not final rules. Check the current Home Affairs page before you apply. Check free at viza dot it dot com.
